主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings Inc announced the cancellation of the Special Meeting of its Series B Preferred Stockholders, originally scheduled for September 13, 2018. The decision followed a court ruling on September 5, 2018, where the Circuit Court for Baltimore City granted a stay pending the conclusion of the appeal of a July 16, 2018 Judgement Order. The order required the company to hold a special meeting to elect directors. The company had previously filed an appeal of the Judgement Order. The cancellation of the meeting reflects the ongoing legal proceedings and the company's appeal process.
